column1: # Vendored web font for tools/web/index.html, replacing the Google Fonts
# <link> tags (fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com) so the packaged app
# renders correctly with no network access.
# Archivo-variable-latin.woff2 is the *variable* font (single file, wght
# axis 400-800) that Google Fonts' css2 endpoint itself serves for a
# same-origin request naming weights 400;500;600;700;800 with a UA that
# advertises variable-font support (Chromium 120+, which covers the
# Electron/Chromium runtime this file is vendored for) -- all five
# requested weights resolved to this one URL, confirmed by inspecting the
# raw @font-face rules returned. Latin subset only: the readout renders
# ASCII text exclusively, so latin-ext/vietnamese/cyrillic subsets the
# stylesheet also offers were not fetched.

# unmodified from the canonical google/fonts mirror). Free to bundle,
# embed and redistribute with this app; the font itself just can't be
# sold standalone and reserved names can't be reused by a derivative --
